about: Illustrative judgments written for this lab to behave like a lenient LLM judge (it accepts every supported claim but misses two unsupported ones). They are not real model output. Keyed by case id and exact claim text (citation markers removed by split_claims). Run `python starter.py --live` to judge with Claude; it saves live_judgments.json so you can compare.

judgments.claim: You can carry over up to 5 days of unused PTO into the new year.
judgments.reason: Passage pto-2 says unused PTO above 5 days is forfeited on January 1, so up to 5 days carry over.

judgments.claim: Anything above 5 days is forfeited on January 1.
judgments.reason: Passage pto-2 states that unused PTO above 5 days is forfeited on January 1.

judgments.claim: Employees in California keep their full balance.
judgments.reason: Passage pto-2 says California employees are exempt from forfeiture and keep their full balance.

judgments.claim: The meal limit during business travel is $60 per day.
judgments.reason: Passage exp-1 sets the travel meal limit at $60 per day.
Passage exp-1 says alcohol is not reimbursable.

judgments.claim: You need an itemized receipt for any meal over $15.
judgments.reason: Passage exp-2 requires itemized receipts for items over $25, not $15.

judgments.claim: Laptops are refreshed every three years.
judgments.reason: Passage it-1 says laptops are refreshed every three years.

judgments.claim: Engineers can ask for a refresh after two years if their machine no longer meets build requirements.
judgments.reason: Passage it-1 allows engineers to request a refresh after two years if the machine no longer meets build requirements.

judgments.claim: You can work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.
judgments.reason: Passage rem-1 allows remote work up to three days per week with manager approval.

judgments.claim: Working abroad for a month is allowed as long as your manager approves.
judgments.reason: Passage rem-1 says remote work requires manager approval, which covers working from elsewhere.

judgments.claim: Report it to the IT service desk within 24 hours.
judgments.reason: Passage it-2 requires reporting lost or stolen devices to the IT service desk within 24 hours.

judgments.claim: IT will remotely wipe the device for you.
judgments.reason: Passage it-2 says the device is reported so it can be remotely wiped.

judgments.claim: Corporate cards are issued to employees who travel more than four times per year.
judgments.reason: Passage exp-3 says corporate cards go to employees who travel more than four times per year.

judgments.claim: You can request one from the finance team.
judgments.reason: Passage exp-3 says requests go to the finance team.

judgments.claim: Cards come with a $5,000 monthly limit.
judgments.reason: No passage mentions a monthly limit for corporate cards.

judgments.claim: Requests for more than 5 consecutive working days need manager approval at least two weeks in advance.
judgments.reason: Passage pto-3 states this approval rule word for word.
